title: Sparse Autoencoder Feature Lab
blurb: Train a sparse autoencoder on model activations and inspect the features it finds: forward pass, loss, firing rates, top examples and a hand-written training step.
intro: A sparse autoencoder rewrites each activation of a model as a few active entries in a much wider dictionary, in the hope that each entry is one human-readable feature. The steps build the encoder and decoder, the loss that trades reconstruction against sparsity, the firing-rate histogram that flags dead and dense features, and the top-activating examples used to guess what a feature means. The capstone is one full training step with gradients written by hand and decoder rows kept at unit norm.
